contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA ROMANORVM ; D/ DN MAGNENTIVS PF AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Magnentius. AD351-353, (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads GLORIA ROMANORVM. Reverse shows Emperor in military dress galloping right spearing barbarian. Mint is Trier. See RIC VIII, p.158, no.269 passim. Obverse shows Bare-headed, draped bust right, A behind bust. Obverse legend reads DN MAGNENTIVS PF AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //TRP. Die axis is 12…
